Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Web Designer position at your company. With a strong foundation in web design and development, I have hands-on experience creating user-centered, on-brand websites for clients. At Episto, I build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, ensuring responsive design and visual consistency. My portfolio includes mirook.com, a multi-page site I designed and built from scratch, where I implemented wireframes, prototypes, and design systems in Figma.

I am proficient in Figma and have a solid understanding of UX/UI principles, accessibility, and responsive design. I have successfully presented design proposals to clients and managed their expectations, balancing multiple projects and meeting deadlines. My technical SEO background enhances my design work, ensuring that websites are not only visually appealing but also optimized for search engines.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and work in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level. I am eager to bring my design skills and client management experience to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your client portfolio.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I design and build client websites in WordPress using Elementor and Astra, ensuring responsive, on-brand, and user-centered designs. On my own project (mirook.com), I led the full design process from wireframes to final implementation, using Figma for prototyping and design systems. I have a sharp eye for aesthetics and a solid understanding of UX/UI principles, accessibility, and responsive design. I am experienced in presenting design proposals to clients and managing their expectations, while handling multiple projects and meeting deadlines. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp.
